title: 航空構造力学Ⅰ
subtitle: Mechanics of Aircraft Structures I
keywords: Structural configuration 2.Torsion, bending, and tension 3.Buckling of long column 4.Buckling of flat plate 5.Effective width
educationalGoal: Students will learn (1) Slender bar under torsional, bending, and tensile load (2) Buckling of long column under compression load (3) How to analyze the buckling load of thin flat plate (4) Concept of effective width of flat plate with stiffeners
advice: On the basis of knowledge learned in subjects such as ‘Strength of Materials' and ‘Strength of Materials for Aircraft Structures’, student will learn the advanced mechanics for aircraft structures. We will cover the following materials: (1) Stress of bar under combination of torsional, bending, and tensile load (2) Buckling of long column under compression load (3) Buckling of thin flat plate (4) Buckling and effective width of plate with stiffeners Students should thoroughly review what they have learned in ‘Strength of Materials' and ‘Strength of Materials for Aircraft Structures’ before taking this course.
books: Basis of Understanding Strength of Materials -Second Edition, Kyoritsu Syuppan, 2013
requiredKnowledge: Basic knowledge of Strength of Materials and Strength of Materials for Aircraft Structures.

activityGoals.body: Be able to calculate the maximum principal stress of the bar under both torsional and tensile loads
Be able to calculate the buckling load of long columns with various ends’ conditions
Be able to calculate buckling load of thin flat plates
Be able to understand the concept of effective width and calculate the effective width of plate with stiffeners

achievementLevels.ideal: 1) Calculate the maximum principal stress and the maximum shear stress of the bar under both torsional and tensile loads 2) Calculate the buckling load of long columns with various ends’ conditions 3) Calculate the buckling load of a flat plate under various constraint conditions 4) Fully understand the concept of effective width and accurately calculate the effective width of plate with stiffeners
achievementLevels.standard: 1) Calculate the maximum principal stress of the bar under both torsional and tensile loads 2) Calculate the buckling load of a long column pin-support at both ends. 3) Calculate the buckling load of a flat plate simply supported at all edges 4) Explain the concept of effective width
